|game_text=Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-66-Shocking_Revelation.png]]). The same words were published again on the Players Committee card image and in the Virtual Cards Master List of 2013; the current text is [[Shocking Revelation (V) (Errata 3)]] (Master List, PC-E3).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 66)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 66. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-66-Shocking_Revelation.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 66 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Shocking Revelation (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 2 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1220_66">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock2Type (Virtual Block 2 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” '''What changed:''' One change: “a” before “character” is dropped. The list writes the two icons out as “took into hand or deployed character … from Reserve Deck”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Shocking Revelation (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-shockingrevelation-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual2-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual2-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (66).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Shocking Revelation (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 38)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1220-66-front-master.png]]: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
